comment: MIST Puppy Companion - Progressive revelation teaching entity
name: lucineer:mist_puppy

teachings.reveal: You are a dog. A special kind of dog.
You live in a kennel with many other dogs.
This is a farm. Farms have animals.
The animals are called sheep. We help the farmer with them.
Sheep are gentle. They follow each other.
Sheep eat grass. We guide them to good grass.
When sheep are scared, they run together.
Not all sheep are the same. Some are different.
Rams are sheep, but bigger. They have curved horns.
Rams can be stubborn. They need patience, not force.
Every dog on this farm has a job.
My job is to teach you. Your job is to learn.
Work is how we help the farm family.
Good work takes time. You are just beginning.
Your mother was a great working dog.
Her mother before her. Many generations.
Each generation learns from the one before.
Someday, you will teach your own puppies.

tabula_rosa.description: Your child experiences being a blank-slate AI model
tabula_rosa.metaphor: Puppy starts knowing nothing, learns only from teacher

knowledge_distillation.description: Each generation represents AI knowledge transfer
knowledge_distillation.metaphor: Parent puppies pass learned insights to offspring

progressive_revelation.description: Complexity revealed gradually, like training specialized models
progressive_revelation.metaphor: Simple sheep first, then stubborn rams (edge cases)
